summary.verdict_desc:
本期计数 7 红 / 9 黄 / 9 绿，红灯比例由连续 5 期的 24.0% 跳升至 28.0%、加权风险分由 40.0% 升至 46.0%，两轴为泡沫成熟度 60.0（亢奋 Euphoria，与上期持平）· 破裂临近度 36.7（零星火花，由 26.7 抬升 10.0 分）。**本期只发生了两处颜色迁移，但都在 trigger 轴上，且其中一处是本监测启动以来最重的一次**：① 市场广度由绿直接转红（两级），8/21 收盘仅约 33% 的标普成分股在自身 50 日线上方，较上期 64% 腰斩、击穿 40% 红线；② 数据中心 ABS 利差由绿转黄。动量净 +3（3 恶化 / 0 好转），未达 ±4 的强制提示阈值，但这是本监测开始以来的最大单周恶化。

先说广度这一格，因为本期判读的重量几乎全压在它身上。本周债市抛售主导了风险资产：8/17 标普连跌第三日、8/19 财政部压低长端收益率的方案落空、道指单日 -700 点、半导体板块周内 -5%，指数周线 -1.4% 终结三周连涨——但指数只跌 1.4%、中位数个股却跌到 33% 的成分股掉出 50 日线，这个缺口本身就是「头部独撑」的定义，也是 2000 年 2 月的核心特征。旁证一致：标普与自身 50 日线的距离由 +3.7% 压缩至 +1.9%、与 200 日线由 +10% 降至 +8.3%，Money Flow Breadth 由 80% 反转至 75%，MACD 出现春季以来首次看跌交叉。**但必须同时说明数据可信度**：barchart / investing / macromicro / marketinout 四个实时源本期全部 egress 受限，33% 仅由单一二手源支撑（两次独立检索一致、且与本周价格行为自洽）。按本仓库的反锚定纪律，这一格已如实标注为本期结论权重最大而交叉印证最薄之处，下期须优先复核；若下期证实为误读，判读会退回上期格局。

第二处迁移在信用轴：dc_abs_spread 由绿转黄。上期判绿的依据是「AAA 段最紧、基准利差未现 50bps+ 走阔」，本期「收窄」一侧不再成立——Bloomberg 报最近三笔数据中心商业地产抵押债中有两笔被迫在初始价格指引之上加价才卖得掉；hyperscaler 债对宽口径 IG 指数的利差由 2025 年初的 20-25bps 扩至 7 月约 35bps、H1 一度近 50bps；IG hyperscaler 债认购覆盖率由 2 月约 5 倍降至 7 月不足 2 倍；2026 年 hyperscaler 债发行已达 $2200 亿、同比多出约 $2070 亿，供给自身在推高清算利差。尚不足 50bps+ 的全面走阔故不转红，但信用面第一次出现了两格同时冒烟（neocloud 续黄，CoreWeave 5 年 CDS 约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率）。与之呼应的是本周最大的一笔资金面事件：Broadcom 就为 Anthropic（及 OpenAI）定制芯片的融资向贷款人寻求 $600-800 亿债务（CNBC 称上看 $700 亿，优先约 $450 亿 + 次级约 $350 亿，总额或达 $1000 亿，Blackstone/Apollo 参与），为本年度单笔最大、也是本监测记录以来最大的一笔 AI 债务交易；台账年内可追溯流水由 $1290 亿升至约 $1995 亿。另有一处台账修正：Nvidia 对 OpenAI 俄亥俄项目的融资担保按 8/17 SEC 文件由传闻的 $2500 亿正式下修为「最多 $1050 亿」——这是本轮 vendor financing 首次出现自我设限，是本期少数向好的二阶信号。

反向证据同样必须给足，本期有两条且都很硬：① 真实推理需求在加速——OpenRouter 官方 API 显示近 30 日 302.9 万亿 tokens、环比 +32.1%（上期 275.0T / +25.9%），8/22 单日 14.1T 创序列新高；在广度崩、内部人卖、信用分层的同一周，底层用量不但没走软还上了台阶。② 前沿能力进展修复了上期的松动——HLE 榜 8/22 由 Claude Opus 5 以 64.7% 领跑，较台账上期 53.3% 一个季度内相对提升 21%，远超绿灯门槛；ARC-AGI-2 在 85% 逼近饱和后按规则轮换至 ARC-AGI-3，GPT-5.6 Sol 以 7.8% 成为首个通过验证击败该基准游戏的模型（3 月时全部前沿模型 <1%）；METR 亦指出近期倍增速度快于最初的 7 个月。上期点名「全表最需下期复核」的两处绿灯，本期是向好而非恶化。

判读：基础档位按 red_pct 28.0%（≥25、<40）本落中度警戒，但估值 2 红（CAPE 41.2、前 5 权重 27.3%）叠加资金面 3 红（Mag4 FCF、VC 占比 70%、NVDA 客户投资 43%）触发**估值 + 资金面双类共振强制升级**，维持高风险预警；两轴升级（stage ≥60 且 trigger ≥50）本期仍未触发——trigger 由 26.7 抬到 36.7，是本监测记录以来最接近 50 的一次，但仍差 13.3 分；降档滞回不适用。也就是说本期档位未变，但**档位内部的位置明显右移**，且升级依据正在由「共振规则」向「两轴规则」过渡。

历史相似度：最像 2000-02（互联网泡沫顶前 1 个月）82%，较上期 76% 抬升 6pt，为本监测记录以来最高；次为 1999-06（72%）、2021-11（70%），2007-10（50%）最不像。**这 6pt 全部来自广度与 ABS 两格——上期点名的与 2000-02 的五处差异，本期关掉了其中一处**：市场广度不再是差异（2000-02 该格为红，本期同为红）。剩余四处差异是：NVDA 远期 PE 仍便宜（约 24x vs 2000 龙头约 60x，且是唯一的完全对立项）、宽口径 HY 信用仍紧（275bps）、AI IPO 未成洪流（Anthropic 公开 S-1 至 8/23 仍未释出，但窗口已收窄到「最快本月底」）、Fed 为维持（68.4%）而非明确加息。接下来确认是否进入顶部前夜，就看这四格：其中 IPO 一格已到临界，Anthropic 公开 S-1 一旦释出并撞上已经转红的广度，就是典型的「发行洪流遇上流动性收缩」。

分母提醒：N=25 下 7 红对应 28.0%，跨期趋势以方向为主。另有一格本期按纪律新标 suspect_static：私募二级标价的两个核心原始值（Anthropic $1.2T / OpenAI $908B）已连续 4 期逐位不变，且均可追溯到同一批 4-7 月报道而非本期新成交——二级标价本应随行就市，4 期不动更可能是源头停更；hy_oas 上期的 static 标记则因 271→275bps 解除。一句话：连续五周钉在 24% 的头条本期终于动了，动因是引线侧而非泡沫侧——泡沫成熟度一分未涨，破裂临近度却抬升 10 分，与 2000 年 2 月的相似度创下新高；但最重的那格证据最薄，所以下期第一件事是复核广度，第二件事是 Nvidia 8/26 财报与 Anthropic 的公开 S-1。（动量净 +3，未及 +4 阈值，但为本监测启动以来最大单周恶化。）
summary.verdict_desc_en:
This period prints 7 red / 9 yellow / 9 green. The red share jumps from five straight readings at 24.0% to 28.0% and the weighted risk score from 40.0% to 46.0%, with the two axes at bubble maturity 60.0 (Euphoria, unchanged) and rupture proximity 36.7 (Sparks, up 10.0 points from 26.7). Only two indicators changed color, but both sit on the trigger axis and one is the heaviest single move since this monitor began: market breadth went straight from green to red, a two-level jump, with only about 33% of S&P 500 members closing above their own 50-day average on Aug 21, half of last period's 64% and through the 40% line; and data-center ABS spreads went from green to yellow. Net momentum is +3 (3 deteriorations, 0 improvements), short of the ±4 threshold that forces a call-out, but it is the largest weekly deterioration on record here.

Start with breadth, because almost the entire weight of this issue rests on it. A Treasury selloff drove risk assets all week: the S&P fell for a third day on Aug 17, the Treasury's plan to subdue long-end yields fell flat on Aug 19 and the Dow dropped 700 points, semiconductors lost about 5% on the week, and the index closed down 1.4%, snapping a three-week winning streak. Yet the index fell only 1.4% while enough of the median names broke down to leave just 33% above their 50-day line. That gap is the definition of narrow leadership and was the core feature of February 2000. The corroborating detail agrees: the S&P's cushion over its own 50-day average compressed from +3.7% to +1.9% and over the 200-day from +10% to +8.3%, Money Flow Breadth reversed from 80% to 75%, and the MACD printed its first bearish crossover since the spring. The confidence caveat has to be stated in the same breath: Barchart, Investing.com, MacroMicro and MarketInOut were all egress-blocked this run, so the 33% rests on a single secondary source — one that two independent searches returned consistently and that is coherent with the week's price action, but a single source nonetheless. Per this repository's anti-anchoring discipline the cell is labeled as carrying the heaviest conclusion on the thinnest corroboration, to be re-verified first next period; if it proves to be a misread, the verdict reverts to last period's configuration.

The second move is on the credit axis, where dc_abs_spread went from green to yellow. Last period's green rested on the AAA strip being tightest with no 50bps-plus widening in benchmark spreads, and the 'tightening' half of that no longer holds. Bloomberg reports that two of the last three commercial mortgage bonds funding data centers had to price wider than initial talk to clear; the spread of hyperscaler bonds over the broad investment-grade index widened from 20-25bps in early 2025 to about 35bps by July, touching nearly 50bps in the first half; subscription coverage on investment-grade hyperscaler deals fell from roughly 5x in February to under 2x in July; and 2026 hyperscaler issuance has reached $220B, some $207B more than the same period last year, with supply itself pushing clearing spreads wider. It falls short of a broad 50bps-plus move so it does not turn red, but for the first time two credit cells are smoking at once, with neocloud_credit still yellow on CoreWeave's five-year CDS near 855bps and its implied ~50% default probability. The week's largest capital event fits the same picture: Broadcom is in talks with lenders for $60-80B of debt to fund custom chips for Anthropic and OpenAI — CNBC puts it at upwards of $70B, roughly $45B senior and $35B junior with a total that could reach $100B, with Blackstone and Apollo involved — the single largest AI debt transaction of the year and the largest this monitor has recorded, lifting the ledger's traceable year-to-date flow from $129.0B to about $199.5B. One ledger correction runs the other way: the Nvidia financing guarantee for OpenAI's Ohio project was formalized at 'up to $105B' in the Aug 17 SEC filing, down from the rumored $250B — the first instance of self-imposed restraint in this vendor-financing cycle and one of the few favorable second-order signals in the issue.

The counter-evidence deserves equal weight, and this period it is both plentiful and hard. First, real inference demand is accelerating: OpenRouter's official API shows 302.9 trillion tokens over the last 30 days, up 32.1% sequentially against 275.0T and +25.9% last period, with Aug 22's 14.1 trillion the highest single day in the series. In the same week that breadth collapsed, insiders sold and credit began to tier, underlying usage did not merely hold — it stepped up. Second, frontier progress resolved last period's wobble in the favorable direction: the HLE leaderboard on Aug 22 has Claude Opus 5 at 64.7% against the 53.3% carried in the ledger, a 21% relative gain in one quarter and well clear of the green threshold; ARC-AGI-2 approached saturation at 85% so tracking rotated to ARC-AGI-3 per the spec, where GPT-5.6 Sol became the first verified model ever to beat one of its games at 7.8%, against every frontier model scoring under 1% in March; and METR notes the recent doubling pace runs faster than the original seven months. The two greens flagged last period as most in need of re-checking improved rather than degraded.

Verdict: the base framework puts a 28.0% red share (at or above 25, below 40) at Moderate Caution, but valuation at 2 red (CAPE 41.2, Top-5 weight 27.3%) plus capital at 3 red (Mag4 FCF, VC share at 70%, NVDA customer investment at 43%) fires the dual-category resonance override, holding High Risk Alert. The two-axis upgrade (stage at or above 60 with trigger at or above 50) still does not fire: trigger rose from 26.7 to 36.7, the closest this monitor has come to 50, but it remains 13.3 points short. The downgrade hysteresis does not apply. So the tier is unchanged while the position inside it has moved distinctly to the right, and the basis for the upgrade is migrating from the resonance rule toward the two-axis rule.

Historical similarity: the closest match is February 2000, one month before the dot-com top, at 82% — up 6 points from 76% and the highest reading on record here — followed by June 1999 at 72%, November 2021 at 70%, and October 2007 least alike at 50%. All 6 points came from the breadth and ABS cells, which means one of the five gaps versus the February 2000 vector named last period has now closed: breadth is no longer a difference, since that cell was red then and is red now. The four that remain are NVDA's cheap forward multiple (~24x against ~60x for 2000's leaders, and the only fully opposite cell on the board), broad high-yield credit still tight at 275bps, an AI IPO pipeline that is not yet a flood (Anthropic's public S-1 was still absent as of Aug 23, though the window has narrowed to as soon as month-end), and a Fed that is holding at 68.4% rather than clearly hiking. Those four are what to watch for confirmation of a top's eve, and the IPO cell is already at the cusp: once Anthropic's public S-1 lands against breadth that has already turned red, it is the classic pairing of an issuance flood meeting contracting liquidity.

Denominator reminder: with N=25, seven reds map to 28.0%, so cross-period trends should be read by direction. One further cell picks up a suspect-static flag by discipline this period: the two anchor marks on private secondary pricing, Anthropic at $1.2T and OpenAI at $908B, have printed digit for digit four periods running and both trace back to the same April-July coverage rather than to any fresh trade. Secondary marks are supposed to move with the market, so four flat readings more likely mean the source has gone quiet. The flag on hy_oas clears, meanwhile, as 271 moved to 275bps. In one line: the headline pinned at 24% for five weeks finally moved, and it moved on the fuse rather than the bubble — maturity gained nothing while rupture proximity rose 10 points and the resemblance to February 2000 hit a new high. But the heaviest cell rests on the thinnest evidence, so next period starts by re-verifying breadth, then turns to Nvidia's Aug 26 print and Anthropic's public S-1. (Net momentum +3, below the +4 threshold, but the largest weekly deterioration since this monitor began.)

indicators.note_en: Pulled this run: GuruFocus 24.50 as of the Aug 19 data date (marked down from 25.17 last period), an analyst-based read near 23.8 and StockAnalysis at 22.0 — a 22.0-24.5x band, taken at ~24x. indicators.note: 本期复核仍无折价：Anthropic Caplight 隐含约 $1.2T（较 $965B Series H 溢价约 24%）、OpenAI Caplight 约 $908B（较 $852B 一级溢价约 7%）。两家旗舰均无二级转折价，一级退潮信号未现，维持绿灯。**但本期按纪律标 suspect_static**：$1.2T / $908B 这两个核心原始标价已连续 4 期逐位不变，且均可追溯到同一批 4-7 月的 Caplight 报道，而非本期新成交——二级标价本应随行就市，4 期不动更可能是源头停更而非市场真静止。IPO 定价将很快取代二级标价成为这条线的真读数（Anthropic 公开 S-1 预计本月底），下期须换源核实
indicators.note_en: Re-checked this run with no discount anywhere: Anthropic's Caplight-implied value is ~$1.2T, a ~24% premium to its $965B Series H, and OpenAI is ~$908B, about 7% above its $852B primary. Neither flagship trades at a down-round mark and there is still no sign of the primary market retreating — green. The suspect-static flag is raised this period as discipline requires: those two anchor marks, $1.2T and $908B, have printed digit for digit four periods running and both trace back to the same batch of April-July Caplight coverage rather than to any fresh trade. Secondary marks are supposed to move with the market, so four flat readings more likely mean the source has gone quiet than that the market has. IPO pricing will soon replace secondary marks as the real read on this line, with Anthropic's public S-1 expected by month-end; the source needs to be re-verified next period

indicators.threshold_text: 指引下调=红 / 加速=黄 / 稳健=绿

indicators.note: 本期口径上修而非新指引：卖方汇总把 2026 大五 hyperscaler（含 Oracle）合计 capex 由上期台账 $7400-7700 亿抬到约 $7750-8000 亿，BofA 更把 hyperscaler capex 的中期路径指向 $1.2 万亿；Alphabet 已将 2026 上限由 $1900 亿提到 $2050 亿，Meta 区间抬至 $1250-1450 亿。四大 Q2 单季 capex 合计 $1660 亿、YoY +87%、环比 +27%，YoY 维持约 +80% 量级。仍无一家下调指引，加速本身即不可持续特征，维持黄灯；Nvidia 8/26 财报是下一个催化点
indicators.note_en: What moved this period is the tally, not the guidance: sell-side aggregates lifted 2026 capex for the big five hyperscalers including Oracle from the ledger's $740-770B to roughly $775-800B, and BofA now points the medium-term hyperscaler path toward $1.2T. Alphabet has raised its 2026 ceiling from $190B to $205B and Meta lifted its range to $125-145B. The big four spent a combined $166B in the June quarter alone, up 87% year on year and 27% sequentially, keeping the annual pace near +80%. Nobody has cut, and acceleration is itself the mark of unsustainability — yellow, with Nvidia's Aug 26 print the next catalyst

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20%~0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: 季度指标、Q2 数字不变（Meta Q2 FCF $7.84 亿约 -91%、Amazon TTM -$76 亿、Alphabet Q2 -$58.55 亿，仅 MSFT 正 $196 亿），但本期拿到一处关键新佐证：Alphabet 上半年有息负债增加 111% 至 $980 亿，且 Q2 为其史上首次经营现金流转负。这坐实了「capex 超过自有现金流 → 转向外部融资」的传导链——FactSet 本期专题正是《Hyperscalers Tap External Financing as AI Capex Outruns Cash Flow》。自有燃料耗尽是泡沫晚期典型特征，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: A quarterly measure with the Q2 figures unchanged — Meta's free cash flow of $784M was down about 91%, Amazon's trailing twelve months stands at -$7.6B, Alphabet's Q2 at -$5.855B, and only MSFT is positive at $19.6B — but one important new corroboration landed this period: Alphabet's debt rose 111% to $98B over the first six months of 2026 and its Q2 marked the first cash-flow-negative quarter in company history. That confirms the transmission chain from capex outrunning internal cash to reliance on external funding, which is exactly the subject of FactSet's piece this period, 'Hyperscalers Tap External Financing as AI Capex Outruns Cash Flow.' Running out of self-generated fuel is a hallmark of a late-stage boom — red

indicators.name_zh: AI 占 VC 投资比重
indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 半年度硬数据，本期复核确认 Q3 完整占比仍未发布（PitchBook/Crunchbase 均要到 10 月初），H1 2026 续为最新口径：AI 占全球创投逾 70%（一年前不足 50%）、占美国创投 86%（$3559 亿 / 全美 $4127 亿）；全球 H1 创纪录 $5100 亿，OpenAI + Anthropic 两家独占 43%（$2170 亿）；Q1 单季 AI 全球融资 $2555 亿即已超 2025 全年。远超 50% 红线，维持红灯——本指标的下一个真读点在 10 月初 Q3 数据
indicators.note_en: A semi-annual hard series, and this run confirms no complete Q3 share has been published yet — neither PitchBook nor Crunchbase reports until early October — so H1 2026 remains the governing print: AI took more than 70% of global venture dollars, up from under 50% a year earlier, and 86% of US venture at $355.9B out of $412.7B. Global first-half funding hit a record $510B with OpenAI and Anthropic alone absorbing 43%, or $217B, and Q1's $255.5B of global AI funding by itself exceeded the whole of 2025. Far above the 50% line — red, with the next genuine read arriving with Q3 data in early October

indicators.note: 长期常红（台账内连续第 7 期红），比值本身不动但二阶方向本期首次转为**收敛**：8/17 的 SEC 文件把此前传闻的 $2500 亿 OpenAI 俄亥俄背书正式定为「最多 $1050 亿」，对应初期 4.25GW（另有 3.75GW 选择权），由 SB Energy 建设、OpenAI 20 年租约、2028 年起分期上线。担保层从 $2500 亿降到 $1050 亿是本轮 vendor financing 首次出现的自我设限，值得记一笔——黄仁勋亦公开否认循环性（「OpenAI 会付租金」）。分子口径未变：直接股权承诺约 $400 亿（OpenAI $300 亿）÷ 约 $3000 亿 LTM 收入 ≈ 43%，仍近 Lucent 1999 峰值 24% 的两倍。提醒：直接股权承诺已连续 4 期停在 $400 亿，8/26 财报后 LTM 收入分母将更新，届时比值会机械下移
indicators.note_en: A persistent red, the seventh straight in the ledger, with the ratio itself unmoved but its second derivative turning toward contraction for the first time: an SEC filing on Aug 17 formalized the previously rumored $250B Ohio backstop for OpenAI at 'up to $105B,' covering an initial 4.25GW with an option on a further 3.75GW, built and operated by SB Energy under a 20-year lease to OpenAI and phasing in from 2028. Cutting the guarantee from $250B to $105B is the first instance of self-imposed restraint in this vendor-financing cycle and is worth recording, with Huang publicly rejecting the circularity framing on the grounds that OpenAI pays the lease. The measured inputs are unchanged: direct equity commitments of ~$40B, $30B of it to OpenAI, against ~$300B of LTM revenue, or roughly 43% — still nearly double Lucent's 1999 peak of 24%. One caveat: direct equity commitments have sat at $40B for four periods, and the LTM revenue denominator updates after the Aug 26 print, which will mechanically pull the ratio down

indicators.note: **本期唯一的颜色崩塌，也是全表最重要的一格**：8/21 收盘 S&P 500 仅约 33% 个股在自身 50 日线上方（源：Savvy Investor 8/23 日更，并注明「上周四读数还略低于此、本月出现实质性下滑」），较上期 64% 腰斩，直接击穿 40% 红线、由绿转红（两级）。背景吻合：本周债市抛售主导风险资产，8/19 道指单日 -700 点、8/17 标普连跌第三日、半导体板块周内 -5%，指数周线 -1.4% 终结三周连涨；标普与自身 50 日线的距离由上期 +3.7% 压缩至 +1.9%、与 200 日线由 +10% 降至 +8.3%（Bull Bear Report 8/21），Money Flow Breadth 由 80% 回落至 75% 并反转，MACD 出现春季以来首次看跌交叉。含义：指数跌得少、中位数个股跌得多 = 头部独撑，正是 2000 式顶部结构。**数据可信度声明**：barchart/investing/macromicro/marketinout 四个实时源本期全部 egress 受限，33% 仅有单一二手源支撑（虽两次独立检索一致、且与本周价格行为自洽）；这是本期结论权重最大而交叉印证最薄的一格，下期必须优先复核
indicators.note_en: The one color collapse of the period and the most consequential cell on the board: only about 33% of S&P 500 members closed above their own 50-day average on Aug 21, per the Savvy Investor daily update of Aug 23, which adds that Thursday's reading was slightly lower still and that the month has seen a material decline. That halves last period's 64% and breaks straight through the 40% line, taking this from green to red, a two-level move. The backdrop fits: a bond selloff drove risk assets all week, with the Dow down 700 points on Aug 19, the S&P falling for a third day on Aug 17, semiconductors off about 5% on the week and the index down 1.4%, snapping a three-week winning streak. The S&P's cushion over its own 50-day average compressed from +3.7% to +1.9% and over the 200-day from +10% to +8.3% per the Aug 21 Bull Bear Report, Money Flow Breadth rolled from 80% to 75% and reversed, and the MACD produced its first bearish crossover since the spring. The meaning is that the index fell little while the median stock fell more — narrow leadership, which is precisely the 2000-style top structure. A note on confidence: Barchart, Investing.com, MacroMicro and MarketInOut were all egress-blocked this run, so 33% rests on a single secondary source, albeit one that two independent searches returned consistently and that is coherent with the week's price action. This is the heaviest conclusion on the thinnest corroboration in this issue and must be re-verified first thing next period

By name: AMZN $347.7M, still 74% of the total and dominant on its own, then MU $51.3M, AMD $33.7M, META $14.5M, PLTR $8.7M, MSFT $7.3M and GOOGL $6.7M. Per the spec the stored value is capped at min(ratio, 99). indicators.threshold_text: 洪流=红 / 升温=黄 / 平静=绿

indicators.note: 本期复核：Anthropic 至 8/23 仍未在 EDGAR 释出公开 S-1，但窗口已收窄到「最快本月底」（6/1 保密交表、$965B Series H），路演与定价预期落在 10-11 月；招股材料引用的年化收入口径已到约 $470 亿。OpenAI 于 5 月下旬保密交表、市场预期 9 月挂牌、估值 $1 万亿+；SpaceX 已公开交表（拟募至多 $750 亿、估值 $1.75-1.8 万亿）。三家同场排队意味着未来 6 个月的巨型发行供给史无前例，但 AI 标的实质临近发行的仍只 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 两家、远不足 10 家的「洪流」门槛，维持黄灯。这是本期最接近转红的一格：Anthropic 公开 S-1 一旦释出，配合本周已经转红的市场广度，就是典型的「发行洪流撞上流动性收缩」组合
indicators.note_en: Re-checked this run: as of Aug 23 Anthropic still has no public S-1 on EDGAR, but the window has narrowed to as soon as month-end, following the June 1 confidential filing and the $965B Series H, with a roadshow and pricing expected in October-November; the annualized revenue figure cited around the offering has reached roughly $47B. OpenAI filed confidentially in late May and is expected to list in September at $1T-plus, while SpaceX has filed publicly, raising up to $75B at $1.75-1.8T. Three names queuing together implies an unprecedented supply of mega-offerings over the next six months, but only Anthropic and OpenAI are genuinely close to pricing, far short of the ten-plus that would mark a flood — yellow. This is the cell closest to turning red: once Anthropic's public S-1 lands, arriving alongside the market breadth that has already gone red this week, it forms the classic pairing of an issuance flood meeting contracting liquidity

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: prefetch 走 FRED 官方 API 取 BAMLH0A0HYM2：本期 275bps（观测日 8/20），近 5 个观测日 275/273/275/270/267，较上期 271bps 走阔 4bps。上期因 271 连续 3 期入账而挂的 suspect_static 本期解除——数值确实动了，且方向与本周债市抛售一致。但 4bps 的位移在 500bps 红线面前微不足道：宽口径 HY 仍远低于长期均值约 394bps 与中位数约 452bps，处历史最紧十分位，是当前最支撑多头的一格。关键并读：本周真正的信用压力发生在 AI/DC 分层与 IG 供给端（见 dc_abs_spread），宽口径指数按定义看不见——一个 4bps 的移动与一个板块内 50bps 的分层，本期同时为真
indicators.note_en: The prefetch job pulls BAMLH0A0HYM2 from the official FRED API: 275bps at the Aug 20 observation, with the last five prints at 275/273/275/270/267, four basis points wider than last period's 271. The suspect-static flag raised last period after three consecutive 271s clears here — the number genuinely moved, and in the direction the week's bond selloff implies. But four basis points is nothing against a 500bps line: broad high yield remains far below its ~394bps long-run average and ~452bps median, sitting in the historically tightest decile, and is the single most bull-supportive cell on the board. The essential caveat is that this week's real credit stress showed up in AI and data-center tiering and in investment-grade supply, which a broad index cannot see by construction — a four-basis-point move and a fifty-basis-point sectoral dislocation are both true this period

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ = 红 / 稳定 = 黄 / 收窄 = 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widening 50bps+ = red / Stable = yellow / Tightening = green
indicators.note: **由绿转黄**：上期判绿的依据是「AAA 段最紧、基准利差未现 50bps+ 走阔」，本期这一条不再成立于「收窄」一侧。实证：① Bloomberg 报最近三笔数据中心商业地产抵押债中有两笔被迫在初始价格指引之上加价才卖得掉，过去 12 个月 DC 相关 CMBS 风险溢价整体抬升；② hyperscaler 债对宽口径 IG 指数的利差由 2025 年初的 20-25bps 扩至 7 月约 35bps、H1 一度近 50bps；③ IG hyperscaler 债认购覆盖率由 2 月约 5 倍降至 7 月不足 2 倍；④ 2026 年 hyperscaler 债发行已达 $2200 亿、同比多出约 $2070 亿，供给自身在推高清算利差。量的一侧仍健康：DC ABS 存量由 2020 年 $40 亿升至 2026 年至今 $610 亿（Barclays），KBRA 续给新发预评级，SEC 8 月的证券化指引仍在松绑供给。故非红（尚无基准 AAA 段 50bps+ 的全面走阔），但已明确不是「收窄」——转黄
indicators.note_en: Green to yellow. Last period's green rested on the AAA strip being the tightest segment with no 50bps-plus widening in benchmark spreads; the 'tightening' half of that no longer holds. The evidence: Bloomberg reports that two of the last three commercial mortgage bonds funding data centers had to price wider than initial talk to clear, with risk premiums on data-center CMBS broadly higher over twelve months; the spread of hyperscaler bonds over the broad investment-grade index has widened from 20-25bps in early 2025 to about 35bps by July, touching nearly 50bps during the first half; subscription coverage on investment-grade hyperscaler deals has fallen from roughly 5x in February to under 2x in July; and 2026 hyperscaler issuance has reached $220B, some $207B more than the same period last year, with supply itself pushing clearing spreads wider. Volume remains healthy on the other side: data-center ABS outstanding has grown from $4B in 2020 to $61B year to date per Barclays, KBRA keeps pre-rating new issues, and the SEC's August securitization guidance continues to ease supply. So not red, since there is no broad 50bps-plus move in the benchmark AAA strip — but decidedly no longer tightening, hence yellow
indicators.source_name: Bloomberg / Sage Advisory / Barclays via SFA

indicators.threshold_text: 任何违约/降级=红 / Watch=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any default/downgrade = red / Watch = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯（观察）：本期复核 90 日内仍无评级机构对 CoreWeave / Nebius / Nscale / Lambda / Crusoe 的已确认降级、违约或压力交换——本期唯一「降级」是卖方分析师把 CoreWeave 调至 Hold，不属评级事件，门槛未破。压力仍集中在市场定价一侧且未缓解：CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 约 855bps、隐含约 50% 五年违约概率，Q1 利息支出翻倍至 $5.36 亿、FCF -$47.1 亿、债务本金 $251 亿，而 2026 年 $310-350 亿 capex 对应约 $62 亿 TTM 收入；公司自 2022 年起 FCF 持续为负且属投机级。本周债市抛售把 AI 融资成本推得更高，对这类靠滚动融资的主体是直接压力。信用轴上唯一持续冒烟的火星，且本期 dc_abs_spread 转黄后，它不再是孤例
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow on Watch: re-checked this run, there is still no confirmed rating-agency downgrade, default or distressed exchange at CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda or Crusoe within 90 days. The only downgrade this period came from a sell-side analyst moving CoreWeave to Hold, which is not a ratings event, so the threshold holds. The stress remains concentrated in market pricing and has not eased: CoreWeave's five-year CDS sits near 855bps, implying roughly a 50% five-year default probability, Q1 interest expense doubled to $536M, free cash flow was -$4.71B against $25.1B of debt principal, and 2026 capex needs of $31-35B stand against roughly $6.2B of trailing revenue, with the company junk-rated and free-cash-flow negative since 2022. This week's bond selloff pushed AI funding costs higher still, which bears directly on borrowers that depend on rolling their financing. It is the one cell on the credit axis that keeps smoking — and with dc_abs_spread turning yellow this period, it is no longer smoking alone

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >=70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green (dot-com peak: 80-100%)
indicators.note: 周度增量台账（距 8/9 完整对账 14 天，未到 28 天）。**本周边际是全年最重的一次**：新增约 $705 亿——① Broadcom 就一笔为 Anthropic（及 OpenAI）定制 AI 芯片的融资向贷款人寻求 $600-800 亿债务（Bloomberg 8/20、CNBC 8/21 称「上看 $700 亿」，结构为优先约 $450 亿 + 次级约 $350 亿，总额或达 $1000 亿；Blackstone、Apollo 参与洽谈，系其 6 月 $350 亿 Anthropic 算力合作的延续），按 $700 亿计入并标注为**在市未定价**；② 数据中心开发商 5C 获约 $5 亿新融资。台账年内可追溯流水由 $1290 亿升至约 $1995 亿（含 Broadcom；不含则约 $1295 亿）。一处台账修正：表外担保项下的「Nvidia-OpenAI $2500 亿融资担保」按 8/17 SEC 文件下修为 $1050 亿。比值维持约 55%（区间 50-60%）：分子仍锚 MS 全口径 2026E 约 $5700 亿、分母全口径 capex 约 $1.04 万亿。**口径诚实声明**：台账 YTD 折年约 $3100 亿，较 $5700 亿锚定值偏离 >15%，因周度检索只能抓到头条级 deal、系统性漏记私募信用与表外分笔，台账应读作下限而非全量；两者并呈，以锚定值定档
indicators.note_en: Weekly incremental ledger, fourteen days since the Aug 9 full reconciliation and short of 28. This is the heaviest weekly margin of the year: roughly $70.5B added. Broadcom is in talks with lenders for $60-80B of debt to fund custom AI chips for Anthropic and OpenAI — Bloomberg on Aug 20 and CNBC on Aug 21 put it at 'upwards of $70B,' structured as roughly $45B senior and $35B junior with a total potentially reaching $100B, with Blackstone and Apollo among those in discussions, extending the $35B Anthropic compute partnership announced in June. It is booked at $70B and explicitly flagged as in-market and unpriced. Data-center developer 5C separately secured about $500M of new financing. The ledger's traceable year-to-date flow rises from $129.0B to roughly $199.5B including Broadcom, or about $129.5B excluding it. One ledger correction: the off-balance-sheet 'Nvidia-OpenAI $250B financing guarantee' is marked down to $105B per the Aug 17 SEC filing. The ratio holds at ~55% on a 50-60% band, with the numerator anchored to Morgan Stanley's all-in 2026E of ~$570B over ~$1.04T of all-in capex. In the interest of honesty about methodology: the ledger's year-to-date run-rate annualizes to roughly $310B, more than 15% below the $570B anchor, because a weekly search only catches headline deals and systematically misses private credit and off-balance-sheet tranches. The ledger should be read as a floor rather than a full count; both figures are presented, and the anchor sets the band

indicators.threshold_text_en: Contraction = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: prefetch 走 OpenRouter 官方 datasets API（rankings-daily）：近 30 日 302.9 万亿 tokens、前 30 日 229.3 万亿，环比 +32.1%（数据截至 8/22）。绝对量与增速双双上台阶——上期 275.0T / +25.9%，本期总量 +10.1%、增速再提 6.2pt；日度尾部 8/16-8/22 为 10.4/13.3/12.7/12.1/12.1/13.9/14.1 万亿，8/22 单日 14.1T 创序列新高。**这是本期唯一强力的反向证据**：广度崩、内部人卖、信用分层同时发生的一周，真实推理需求不但没有走软，环比还在加速——本轮与 2000 年最本质的区别仍在于底层用量是真实且在复利的。维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: The prefetch job pulls OpenRouter's official datasets API (rankings-daily): 302.9 trillion tokens over the last 30 days against 229.3 trillion in the prior 30, up 32.1% through Aug 22. Both the level and the growth rate stepped up — last period read 275.0T and +25.9%, so volume rose a further 10.1% and the growth rate gained 6.2 points. The daily tail for Aug 16-22 runs 10.4/13.3/12.7/12.1/12.1/13.9/14.1 trillion, with Aug 22's 14.1T the highest single day in the series. This is the one piece of forceful counter-evidence in the issue: in a week when breadth collapsed, insiders sold and credit began to tier, real inference demand did not soften but accelerated. The most fundamental difference from 2000 remains that the underlying usage is real and compounding — green

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌>15%/供过于求=红 / 阴跌=黄 / 稳定或上涨=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: -15%+ MoM / glut = red / Drifting lower = yellow / Stable-to-rising = green
indicators.note: 本期实抓价点：H100 on-demand 起价 $2.19、跨提供商 $2.19-11.06，spot $1.03-2.00；H200 on-demand JarvisLabs $3.99、Nebius $4.50、RunPod $4.39，spot 约 $3.50-4.40。与台账上期（H100 $1.49-6.98 / Jarvis $2.69，H200 $3.99 / spot $3.50-4.40）对比，主力价位逐点持平，无环比下跌、更无 >15% 的崩塌，维持绿灯。软信号继续累积并首次被卖方明说：Blackwell 放量、更便宜的 H100 与新增 B200 层级、加上数据中心新增产能，正在「抵消持续的训练需求并限制价格反弹」——即价格已从上行转为顶部盘整。算力商品价格是本体系里唯一直接看供需成交价的指标，2000 年暗光纤正是在电信股崩盘前先崩，故这格由绿转黄将是极重的信号，下期续盯
indicators.note_en: Price points pulled this run: H100 on-demand starts at $2.19 and spans $2.19-11.06 across providers with spot at $1.03-2.00; H200 on-demand is $3.99 at JarvisLabs, $4.50 at Nebius and $4.39 at RunPod, with spot around $3.50-4.40. Against the prior ledger — H100 at $1.49-6.98 with JarvisLabs at $2.69, H200 at $3.99 and spot $3.50-4.40 — the main price points are flat, with no sequential decline and nothing close to a 15% break, so this stays green. The soft signal keeps building and is now stated outright on the sell side: the Blackwell ramp, cheaper H100s, new B200 tiers and added data-center capacity are together 'offsetting persistent training demand and limiting sharp rebounds' — prices have moved from rising to topping out. This is the only indicator in the framework that reads an actual transaction price for compute supply and demand, and dark fiber collapsed before telecom equities did in 2000, so a turn to yellow here would carry unusual weight. Watch it next period

indicators.name_zh: AI 收入增速的二阶导
indicators.threshold_text: 减速=红 / 平稳=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decel = red / Flat = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，但本期含一处台账修正。**修正**：Anthropic 年化 run rate 按 TechCrunch 8/17 报道为 7 月底约 $650 亿，台账此前记的 $741 亿口径偏高，本期按 $650 亿修订。二阶导据此重算：Anthropic 5 月底约 $470 亿 → 7 月底 $650 亿，两个月 +$180 亿、月均约 +$90 亿，较更早的月均 +$170 亿明显放缓——二阶导仍为负，但降幅比台账原记的 +$45 亿/月温和得多。反向侧：OpenAI 年化约 $400 亿（月约 $33 亿），7 月单月环比 +20%，此前春季长期卡在约 $250 亿后明确再加速。一加一减对冲不变，且 IPO 前两家披露口径（Anthropic 记 gross、OpenAI 近 net，差异约 $80 亿）仍未统一，故不宜据此判方向。维持平稳/黄
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow, with one ledger correction this period. The correction: TechCrunch reported on Aug 17 that Anthropic's annualized run rate stood near $65B at the end of July, so the $74.1B previously carried in the ledger ran high and is revised down to $65B. Recomputing the second derivative on that basis, Anthropic went from roughly $47B in late May to $65B at end-July, adding $18B over two months for about $9B a month against roughly $17B a month earlier — still decelerating, but far less sharply than the $4.5B a month the ledger had recorded. On the other side, OpenAI is annualizing near $40B, roughly $3.3B a month, and grew 20% month over month in July, a clear re-acceleration after holding around $25B through the spring. The offset of one up against one down is unchanged, and with the two companies still reporting on different bases ahead of their offerings — Anthropic gross, OpenAI closer to net, a gap of roughly $8B — the comparison cannot carry a directional call on its own. Flat, yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: 季度调查、本期仍无新的整体生产化读数，沿用 McKinsey Q1 2026 的 72%（2024 为 55%、2020 为 20%），总体部署率高位维持绿灯。本期新增的分层证据把「部署广、价值捕获窄」的裂口挖得更深：agent 口径生产化仅 31%（S&P Global），McKinsey 称任一业务职能内规模化 agent 的企业不超过 10%，Gartner 预测 2027 年前逾 40% 的 agentic AI 项目将被取消（ROI 不清、成本失控、风控不足）；同时 Q1 新发或更新的企业应用中 80% 已内嵌至少一个 agent——「装上了」与「用起来了」之间的差距是这条线真正的风险。头条读数与实际价值捕获的背离若持续到下一次调查，本指标的绿灯含金量会明显下降
indicators.note_en: A quarterly survey with no new headline production figure this period, so McKinsey's Q1 2026 reading of 72% carries — up from 55% in 2024 and 20% in 2020 — and the headline deployment rate stays high, green. The new stratified evidence this period digs the 'deployed widely, capturing narrowly' gap deeper: only 31% of organizations have an agent in production per S&P Global, McKinsey finds no more than 10% scaling agents within any single business function, and Gartner projects that more than 40% of agentic AI projects will be cancelled before 2027 on unclear ROI, runaway costs and inadequate controls. At the same time, 80% of enterprise applications shipped or updated in Q1 now embed at least one agent — the distance between installed and actually used is the real risk on this line. If the headline continues to diverge from value capture through the next survey, the quality of this green will degrade noticeably

indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 订单积压维持纪录（季度指标、本期无新披露，Q2 数字复核确认）：MSFT 商业 RPO $6780 亿（+84% YoY）、AWS $4960 亿（环比 +$1320 亿）、Google 积压 $5140 亿、Oracle RPO $6380 亿，大三 hyperscaler 合计逾 $1.1 万亿。本期新增的质量细节值得记：MSFT 这 $6780 亿的加权平均久期仅 2.3 年、其中未来 12 个月内确认的部分本身仍 +37% YoY——即积压不是靠拉长年限堆出来的远期承诺，近端转化同样在加速；Amazon 称 2027 年计划产能已基本被预订、2028 年产能亦有承诺。绿灯不变；Oracle 积压高度集中于 OpenAI 仍是这格最大的结构性隐患，与本期 ai_ipo_pipeline、nvda_invest_revenue 是同一个交易对手风险的三个切面
indicators.note_en: Backlogs remain at records — a quarterly measure with no new disclosure this period and the Q2 figures re-verified: MSFT commercial RPO of $678B, up 84% year on year, AWS at $496B after adding $132B sequentially, Google's backlog at $514B and Oracle's RPO at $638B, putting the big three above $1.1T combined. One quality detail is worth recording this period: the weighted average duration of Microsoft's $678B is only 2.3 years and the portion converting within twelve months is itself growing 37% year on year, so the backlog is not a pile of distant promises built by stretching contract terms — near-term conversion is accelerating too. Amazon says most of its planned 2027 capacity is already reserved with commitments extending into 2028. Green stands, though Oracle's heavy concentration in OpenAI remains the largest structural exposure here, and together with ai_ipo_pipeline and nvda_invest_revenue it is the same counterparty risk seen from three angles

indicators.threshold_text: 停滞=红 / 放缓=黄 / 正常或加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Stalled = red / Decelerating = yellow / On-trend or accelerating = green
indicators.note: 三层判定，上期标记为「全表最需复核」的两处松动本期均向好解决。**辅锚（决定性）**：HLE 榜 8/22 由 Claude Opus 5 以 64.7% 领跑（次为 Claude Mythos 5 64.5%、Muse Spark 1.1 62.1%），对比台账上期 53.3%，一个季度内 +11.4pp、相对提升 +21%，远超「90 天内相对提升 ≥10%」的绿灯门槛。**基准轮换**：ARC-AGI-2 已在 85% 逼近饱和，按 INDICATORS 规则本期起追踪对象改为 ARC-AGI-3——GPT-5.6 Sol 以 7.8% 刷新 SOTA，并成为首个通过验证击败 ARC-AGI-3 游戏的前沿模型（3 月时全部前沿模型均 <1%，人类 100%）。**主锚**：METR 报告前沿 horizon 续升，Claude Mythos 的 50% 时间跨度已至少 16 小时（METR 明言超 16 小时其现有任务集测量不可靠）；官方全期倍增时间 196 天口径不变，但 METR 指出近期倍增速度快于最初的 7 个月、2026 年已到「数月」量级——上期担心的「倍增时间拉长」并未成立。佐证：近 90 天旗舰密集，无连续两季度无实质提升。维持绿灯，且是本期少数确定性改善的一格
indicators.note_en: A three-layer read in which both of the loose threads flagged last period as most in need of re-checking resolved favorably. The secondary anchor is decisive: the HLE leaderboard on Aug 22 has Claude Opus 5 in front at 64.7%, ahead of Claude Mythos 5 at 64.5% and Muse Spark 1.1 at 62.1%, against 53.3% carried in the ledger — a gain of 11.4 points, or 21% in relative terms, within a single quarter, comfortably clearing the 10% relative-improvement bar for green. On benchmark rotation, ARC-AGI-2 has approached saturation at 85%, so per the spec tracking moves to ARC-AGI-3 from this period, where GPT-5.6 Sol set a new state of the art at 7.8% and became the first verified frontier model ever to beat an ARC-AGI-3 game, against every frontier model scoring under 1% in March while humans solve 100%. On the primary anchor, METR reports frontier horizons still rising, with Claude Mythos at a 50% time horizon of at least 16 hours — METR notes its current task suite cannot reliably measure beyond that — and while the official full-sample doubling time of 196 days is unchanged, METR observes that the recent doubling pace runs faster than the original seven months, on the order of a few months by 2026. Last period's worry about the doubling time lengthening did not hold up. Corroboration: flagship releases stayed dense over 90 days with no two consecutive quarters lacking real gains. Green, and one of the few cells improving with confidence this period

indicators.threshold_text: 任何=红 / 调查=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any confirmed = red / Investigation = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 本期复核仍无针对核心 AI 龙头的正式立案或已确认事件，维持绿灯。监管侧续硬化：SEC 8/5 新设「财报与会计执法单元」（集中财报、会计、审计与证券监管专才，明确追查财报欺诈、会计不当与审计师不当行为），审查部确认 AI 为 2026 年常设检查优先项、逐字核查发行人对自身 AI 能力表述的准确性，8 月证券执法月报亦以此为主线。现有 round-tripping 关切（Nvidia→OpenAI→CoreWeave/Oracle）仍停留在分析师与媒体审视层面——但本周 8/17 那笔 $1050 亿 Nvidia 对 OpenAI 俄亥俄项目的融资担保，把「供应商为客户的租约融资、客户再用其芯片」这一结构第一次写进了 SEC 文件，黄仁勋公开否认循环性本身也说明质疑已到需要 CEO 亲自回应的程度。工具箱已就位、案子尚未来，这仍是全部绿灯里最脆的一格
indicators.note_en: Re-checked this run with still no formal case or confirmed event against a core AI bellwether — green. The regulatory side keeps hardening: the Financial Reporting and Accounting Unit the SEC created on Aug 5 concentrates specialists in financial reporting, accounting, auditing and securities regulation with an explicit mandate over reporting fraud, accounting misconduct and auditor misconduct; the Division of Examinations has confirmed AI as a standing 2026 priority, checking registrants' claims about their own AI capabilities word by word; and August's securities enforcement newsletter runs on the same theme. The existing round-tripping concerns from Nvidia to OpenAI to CoreWeave and Oracle remain at the level of analyst and press scrutiny — but this week's $105B Nvidia guarantee for OpenAI's Ohio project, filed on Aug 17, put the structure of a supplier financing its customer's lease so the customer can buy its chips into an SEC document for the first time, and the fact that Huang publicly rebutted the circularity charge himself shows the questioning has reached a level requiring a CEO's answer. The toolkit is in place and the case has not arrived — still the most brittle green on the board

indicators.value_display: 维持高利率 (维持 68.4% / 加息 31.6%)
indicators.threshold_text: 加息=红 / 通胀压力=黄 / 降息=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike = red / Inflation pressure = yellow / Cut = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，模态读数基本持平：截至 8/20，CME FedWatch 对 9/16 会议隐含「维持 3.50-3.75%」概率 68.4%、加息 31.6%（上期 67.6% / 32%）。7 月以 9:3 投票维持，7 月就业数据意外走弱压住了部分加息押注，期货一度把首次紧缩推到 12 月。**但本期真正的宏观压力不在政策路径而在长端**：本周美债抛售才是风险资产回落的主因（8/19 财政部压低收益率的方案落空、道指 -700 点，通胀与政府债务担忧令收益率高企），并直接传导到 AI 融资成本与本期转黄的 dc_abs_spread。按规则模态仍是维持而非隐含加息，故不转红——但要留意本指标的定义（政策利率方向）本期漏掉了实际收紧的来源（期限溢价）
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow with the modal read essentially flat: as of Aug 20, CME FedWatch implies a 68.4% chance the Sept 16 meeting holds at 3.50-3.75% against 31.6% for a hike, versus 67.6% and 32% last period. July held on a 9-3 vote, unexpectedly soft July jobs data damped some of the hike pricing, and futures at one point pushed the first tightening out to December. But the real macro pressure this period sits at the long end rather than in the policy path: the Treasury selloff was the proximate cause of the week's risk-asset decline, with the Treasury's plan to subdue yields falling flat on Aug 19 and the Dow dropping 700 points as inflation and government-debt worries kept yields elevated, and it transmitted straight into AI funding costs and the dc_abs_spread cell that turned yellow this period. By the rule the modal outcome is still a hold rather than an implied hike, so this does not turn red — but note that the indicator's definition, the direction of the policy rate, misses where the actual tightening came from this week, namely term premium

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚=红 / 偶发=黄 / 奖励=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment = red / Episodic = yellow / Rewarded = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯：Q2 财报季已结束、无新指引可读，本期复核的是既有反应函数的成色。惩罚侧确有实据——Meta 上调 2026 capex 后当日 -6%，Alphabet 因把上限由 $1900 亿提到 $2050 亿而被市场「panned」，CNBC 明确写「hyperscalers 的激进 AI 支出正在动摇自家股价」。但对侧同样成立且是关键判据：多位投资者表示，任一大型云厂商若实质下调 capex，对市场的打击更大——也就是说市场惩罚的是「烧钱无对价」而非「烧钱」本身，反应函数尚未系统性转负，故不转红。本周半导体 -5% 是利率驱动而非指引驱动，不计入本指标。Nvidia 8/26 财报是下一个真实读点，届时若上调资本相关承诺仍遭抛售，本指标将是最先转红的候选
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow: Q2 season is closed with no new guidance to read, so what this run re-checks is the quality of the existing reaction function. The punishing side has real evidence — Meta fell about 6% the day it raised 2026 capex, Alphabet was panned for lifting its ceiling from $190B to $205B, and CNBC states plainly that hyperscalers' aggressive AI spending is rattling their own stocks. But the other side holds too, and it is the decisive test: multiple investors say that a substantive capex cut from any major cloud provider would hit the market harder still. The market is punishing spending without receipts rather than spending itself, so the reaction function has not turned systematically negative and this does not go red. The week's 5% decline in semiconductors was rate-driven rather than guidance-driven and does not count here. Nvidia's Aug 26 print is the next genuine read, and if raised capital commitments still draw selling then, this becomes the leading candidate to turn red

indicators.threshold_text_en: Widespread acknowledgment = red / Partial = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 对冲表态持续但未成一致，维持黄灯。承认侧：Altman 本月对记者重申许多投机型初创估值虚高、投资者可能被烧，并把当下类比互联网泡沫「聪明人为一个真实的内核过度兴奋」，同时坚称 AI 长期是「巨大净赢」——即承认估值过热但不承认技术过热；Pichai 维持「既理性、又在这样的时刻存在非理性成分」的双面表述；Dimon 的回撤警告仍在。反向侧仍由黄仁勋独扛，本周他不但重申不惧泡沫、还亲自下场否认 $1050 亿俄亥俄担保属循环融资（「不。OpenAI 会付租金」）。关键判据不变：无一家在承认过热的同时收缩支出，capex 指引本期还在集体上修（Alphabet 至 $2050 亿、Meta 至 $1450 亿上限），言行分离维持黄灯而非红灯
indicators.note_en: Hedging continues without becoming unanimous — yellow. On the acknowledging side, Altman told reporters this month that many speculative startups carry inflated valuations and that investors may get burned, likening the moment to the dot-com bubble where smart people get overexcited about a kernel of truth, while insisting AI's long-run impact is a huge net win: conceding that valuations are overheated but not that the technology is. Pichai keeps to his two-sided formulation that the enthusiasm is rational and that there are elements of irrationality in a moment like this, and Dimon's correction warning still stands. On the other side Huang remains alone, this week not only repeating that he does not fear a bubble but personally rebutting the charge that the $105B Ohio guarantee is circular financing — 'No. OpenAI will pay the lease.' The decisive test is unchanged: nobody is conceding an overheated market while cutting spend, and capex guidance was revised up again this period, with Alphabet at $205B and Meta's ceiling at $145B. Words and actions diverge, which keeps this yellow rather than red
